text:
maya: Quick RFC follow-up 3 staging gateway prototype routes by precision profile (fp8/int8/4bit). Goal: shadow/canary per-tenant without touching prod. Safety gates?

sam: Do we validate profile metadata + signature at the gateway or let runtime reject?

maya: Gateway verifies metadata key `precision.profile.v1` and a checksum. If mismatch -> 409 + fallback header.

liam: Perf context: fp8 ~1.6x, int8 ~1.0x (baseline), 4-bit ~2.7x on our infra. Important: avoid merging lanes into same batch.

jess: Ops +1. Route types: shadow|canary|active. Canaries: qps cap + auto-rollback on degscore alarm. I'll add runbook.

arjun: Telemetry: per-token degscore, 1m latency hist, 5m rolling degscore. Shadow sample 2% by default. Auto-fail threshold -> rollback.

maya: Also adding `quality_escrow` flag for tenant cutovers (return 202 until validation job done). Default fallback = fp32 unless X-Allow-Lowbit: true header present.

liam: Runtime note: emit `X-KV-Invalidate: true` when switching lanes to avoid cache poisoning.

jess: Region gating needed; some on-prem regions don't support int4 kernels. Gateway should validate region before routing.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staged deploy started 1 staging-gateway v0.1 -> staging. CI: unit+integration ok.

maya: I'll push a tiny pseudo-config and open a follow-up PR for the runbook.
